visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a black dress with long brown hair runs excitedly through a large, brightly lit piano showroom. She twirls and laughs, passing by several grand pianos, including black and white models. (2) The woman enters through a glass swinging door into the showroom, holding a black wallet and a smartphone. She walks confidently towards the camera while speaking. (3) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a light-colored wooden grand piano. The woman approaches it, touches the surface, and sits on the matching white bench. (4) Close-up shot of the woman's hands with painted nails playing a melody on the piano keys. She has a focused yet dramatic expression, leaning her body as she plays. (5) She stands up and gestures enthusiastically with both hands, expressing great excitement. The background shows more pianos and a large TV screen. (6) A middle-aged man in a dark suit and glasses enters the frame. He stands next to the wooden piano and speaks professionally while gesturing towards it. (7) A close-up reveals the brand name 'Steinway & Sons' on the piano. The man continues explaining features. (8) Upon hearing the price, the woman's facial expression shifts from joy to a frozen, shocked grimace. Cartoonish lightning and thought-bubble effects appear around her head. (9) She recovers with a forced, wide smile, laughing nervously while looking around the room and moving her hands frantically.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with energetic, high-tempo piano BGM accompanied by a woman's high-pitched laughter and enthusiastic shouting. The acoustic environment is bright. (2) A rhythmic pop BGM kicks in as the female voice begins a rapid-fire monologue in Mandarin, exhibiting high arousal and wide pitch variability. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a change in visual scene, though the music continues. (4) The music ducks slightly for a 'ding' SFX as a brand name is highlighted. (5) Live piano playing is heard—a solo classical-style melody—integrated into the mix with the BGM. (6) The salesperson's voice is heard: a calm, professional male tone with low pitch and steady rate, contrasting with the woman's excited interjections. (7) A sudden silence is interrupted by a low-pitched, dramatic meme SFX (bass drop/distortion) followed by a fragment of a sad pop song ('Somebody That I Used To Know') to indicate shock. (8) The final phase features forced, high-pitched laughter from the woman and a return to fast-paced speech as the BGM swells to a close.
